data.desc: John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: JMSB) is the parent company of John Marshall Bank , a Virginia state-chartered bank headquartered in Reston, Virginia . John Marshall Bank serves businesses, professional service firms, non-profits and individuals throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area through eight full-service branches located in Alexandria , Arlington , Loudoun , Prince William , Reston , and Tysons, Virginia , as well as Rockville, Maryland , and Washington, D.C. As of September 30, 2026 , John Marshall Bancorp had total assets of $2.4 billion , total loans of approximately $2 billion and total deposits of approximately $2.1 billion .
